description: T11 LOS line tool (design doc §6). With a shooter selected by clicking its token, a real mouse hover over an enemy unit draws ONE line through BoardRoot/LOSLineVisual from the shooter's base centre to the target's base centre, coloured by the rules engine's own verdict (RulesEngine.unit_sight_line for sight, TerrainManager.unit_has_cover_11e for 13.08 cover). Curated board on co_pretrigger (P2 shooting): Kaptin Badrukk at (400,1200), the Contemptor-Achillus at (1000,1200), the fixture's terrain replaced through TerrainManager.load_terrain_from_save by (a) open ground, (b) a light barricade between them hiding the top of the target's base (visible, not fully visible: cover), (c) a dense ruin across the line. Each sub-check asserts color_slot / los_state, the endpoints against the live token centres, the Line2D colour and 3px screen stroke, the captured pixel's slot colour, and that the rules predicates agree independently; pixel_diff on the los_line band (a part of the line no terrain touches) between (a)/(b) and (b)/(c) is > 5%; hover-off removes the line and its range label.

steps.comment: Player 2's drawn-secondaries review (not under test) is closed so the board is unobstructed.

steps.script:
var d = tree.root.get_node_or_null("SecondaryMissionReviewDialog")
return (d == null or not d.visible) and ToastManager.active_toasts.is_empty()

steps.comment: The hot-seat handoff screen eats input; acknowledge it the way the player's [Enter] does.
The tool's node is installed on BoardRoot and draws nothing before any hover.

Curated board, part 1: Kaptin Badrukk (P2, 40mm, 24" Kustom mega-blasta) and the Contemptor-Achillus (P1, 60mm, VEHICLE: no in-area cover) 15" apart on one horizontal line, and the fixture's terrain replaced through the save-load path by one far-away ruin (decor). Sub-check (a): open ground between them.

steps.script: main.fit_view_to_decision(["U_KAPTIN_BADRUKK_A", "U_CONTEMPTOR-ACHILLUS_DREADNOUGHT_H"])
steps.comment: Frame the pair (deterministic camera: zoom 1.0 centred on the line), so the los_line region is fixed.
Player path: click the shooter's token to select it.
Selecting the shooter opens P2's 'selected to shoot' stratagem window (CLOSE-RANGE DAKKA), which holds the board's input until answered. Not under test: decline it for the phase, as a player would.

main.fit_view_to_decision(["U_KAPTIN_BADRUKK_A", "U_CONTEMPTOR-ACHILLUS_DREADNOUGHT_H"])

(a) Real mouse hover over the candidate target.

Endpoints are the two base centres (board px AND on screen, against the live tokens), the Line2D is painted CONFIRMED_GREEN with a 3px on-screen stroke, and the old red line is gone.
The rendered frame: the pixel a quarter of the way along the line is CONFIRMED_GREEN.
Empty board below the line: no enemy under the cursor.
Tier B: the line (and its range label) disappears on hover-off.
Hover-off really removes the drawn line from the frame.

Curated board, part 2 (b): a light barricade (11e Obscuring) between the units, just above the line near the target. The centre-to-centre sight line passes under it; the lines to the top of the target's base cross it.
